scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrations:apply && vite build && wrangler deploy --minify
scripts.setup: npm run build && wrangler deploy --minify && npm run db:migrations:apply

DB.description: D1 registry for zones and operator audit records. It is provisioned automatically and migrated during deployment.

BOT_TRAFFIC_ANALYTICS.description: R2 bucket containing zone-keyed traffic rollups and monitoring outcomes.

TEAM_DOMAIN.description: The team domain shown when you enable the deployment form's Cloudflare Access toggle, for example `https://your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`.

POLICY_AUD.description: The application AUD tag shown when you enable the deployment form's Cloudflare Access toggle.

CLOUDFLARE_READ_TOKEN.description: Read-only Cloudflare API token used by scheduled GraphQL analytics collection and the model-facing MCP search connection (search only, never execute). Permission: All Domains > Zone Analytics > Read. Scope it to all domains for multi-zone use, or only the registered domains. Do not grant write permissions.

APPROVAL_TOKEN_SECRET.description: A long random cryptographic secret used to sign single-use email approval tokens. Not a Cloudflare API token. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
